submission.justification: Selection-S2 has the highest expected significance (4.1σ), but it fails the hard validation-region requirement. Its data/MC disagreement is 35% against a 10% limit, because its jet-substructure inputs are poorly modelled, so it is excluded. Of the strategies that pass, Selection-S3 (NN on kinematic variables only, 6% disagreement) has the highest expected significance: 3.4σ, compared with 2.6σ for Selection-S1 (cut-based, 3% disagreement). I recommend S3 at a 50% signal-efficiency working point. This is the only working point with documented sensitivity numbers (2025 summary, stat-only). The tools available did not include a way to scan efficiencies, so the working point has not been optimised within the 20-80% range. The 3.4σ figure is stat-only, and adding systematics, including those for the 6% modelling disagreement, will lower it.

requirements.evidence: S3 has the highest significance among options that pass the constraints: 3.4σ vs 2.6σ for S1 (2025 summary, 50% efficiency, stat-only). S2 (4.1σ) is excluded by the validation constraint. The working point was not scanned.

requirements.requirement: Selection is one of the three strategies in candidate_specs.md
